question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e3fcf0fadc192384b618580e90fc97bdd2527d65f6a49065a6d9e6ee1019e2b.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) FUGT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c09ac781e0516a6dddd8bfaad8d8ed7bee5b4db8567519241e84356a47b204d6.png] 

Option 2) PKQJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc03ec824ac54e6899252afe9e8cf019d90df2460249c6348eb103c8acd703b.png] 

Option 3) **MONM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb7e3ed1b9b4438bb534f049657fe8ef073e1161656f00cb58962d31f4cb7488.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65437243de7873cfe5ffb0f206b501faabad2060c7695eca36a74721dfcb5124.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
